source_message.text:
Hey Joseph,
One final-final mechanics tweak that actually makes everything cleaner and simpler to code (no weird half-expiring tickets).
New rule (replaces the previous ticket lifespan description):
→ Every time someone mints with a referral code, the referrer instantly gets two separate tickets added to their NFT:
+1 Small Block Ticket
+1 Big Block Ticket

These are two completely independent counters.
Small Block ($2,500 pool → 5 × $500 draw):
Draw only from Small Block Tickets issued since the last small block.
After the draw, burn/reset all Small Block Tickets to 0.
Big Block ($100,000 pool → 5 × $20,000 draw):
Draw only from Big Block Tickets issued since the last big block.
After the draw, burn/reset all Big Block Tickets to 0.

This way:
Small blocks stay super fair and fresh (no one carries old tickets forward).
Big blocks naturally accumulate (people can see their big block entries climbing over weeks/months).
Metadata is trivial: just show the two counters + permanent badges.

Triggers stay pool-based (small block fires the moment small pool = exactly $2,500, big block when big pool = exactly $100,000). Secondary royalties still fill pools but don’t create tickets.
Everything else stays identical (auto $5 commission, random ticket to existing NFT when no ref used, manual claim, etc.).
This version should be easier to implement and explain to users.
Sorry for the flip-flop — Once you confirm this is cleaner for you too, we’re 100% locked.

Thanks man!

Project Rebuild is my public mission to rebuild my family’s life after losing everything to a seed-phrase mistake.
I’m selling my novella memoir as an unlimited mint NFT ebook, on Base, using my first-of-its-kind FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model).

1\. $5 instant commission every time someone mints with your referral code
2\. Small & Big Block prize tickets every time someone mints with your code
3\. Future BooksOnChain governance token (to buyers, affiliates, and tippers)

Every NFT’s mint number IS its permanent referral code.

→ Or just say “use referral 423”

Where do I find my referral code?
It’s your mint number. You’ll see it:
\- On-chain in your NFT metadata
\- On your Dashboard after minting
\- In your confirmation email (optional)

\### What are Small Block and Big Block prizes?
Small Block: 5 × $500 drawn every ~500 sales (mint + secondary)
Big Block: 5 × $10,000 drawn every ~50,000 sales (mint + secondary)
Pools funded from every sale forever.

\### How are winners selected?
Chainlink VRF — fully on-chain, provably fair, verifiable on Basescan.

\### What are Small & Big Block prize tickets?
One-time entries into the current Small Block and current Big Block draws.
You earn them only by getting people to mint with your code (1 Small + 1 Big per successful referral).
Once the block is drawn, those tickets expire and new referrals count toward the next blocks.

\### How do I claim my rewards?
\- $5 commissions → sent automatically to your wallet
\- Prize wins → announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click here on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz>

\### What are badges?
On-chain badges added to your NFT for hitting referral milestones (2, 10, 50, 100+).
Currently cosmetic + leaderboard flex. In the future they may unlock token-gated chats, discounts, airdrops, DAO weight, etc.

\### Can I mint with fiat (credit card)?
Yes — Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay. No crypto or wallet required.

\### Do I need a wallet to participate?
Only if you want affiliate commissions paid out or to trade the NFT later.

\### What blockchain is this on?
Base (Ethereum L2) — fast, cheap, Coinbase-backed.

\### Are there any hidden fees?
No. Mint = exactly $15. Secondary sales carry a visible $10 flat royalty.

\### What happens if I sell my NFT?
The buyer gets the book, your original mint number (now their referral code), and any badges you earned. Expired prize tickets stay expired.

\### How do I share my referral link/code?
Dashboard → copy full link or just copy your mint number and tell people “use referral 423”.

\### Is this a scam or pyramid scheme?
No. Single-level only. Unlimited supply. Full source verified on Basescan. I earn exactly $4 on every sale forever — same cut on mints and every secondary sale.

\### How do I contact support?
No Discord yet (will launch once we have real traction).
